selected.name: 借敌人真实发射开短门

parameters.relationship: actual native enemy attack commitment supplies a short gate opening

proposal_source.note: Actual native enemy attack commit drives isolated ShotLatch relay. Exact selected case and frozen binding preserve native seed damage and original gate clock/anti-pinch.

selected.distinct_rationale: Player exposure lets native enemy AI commit to attack; a new isolated relay uses that real commitment to open the original timed gate while the original enemy projectile continues. Moving early under the enemy stand blocks line of sight and prevents the useful attack; waiting too long takes actual seed damage. Existing direct waits0/20/45 fail before crossing,75 succeeds as legitimate timing,120 takes real damage. Unlike an uncontrolled periodic hazard, player position controls whether the useful hostile commit happens. This is expose-to-trigger then leave-before-impact world interaction, not a renamed shoot switch.
selected.parent: native hostile attack commitment supplies world access

Thorned roof repairs actual recoil-over-roof bypasses.

selected.name: 活敌压区维持门

proposal_source.note: Historical design cards describe ancestry; selected case and frozen source bind the repaired exact geometry/semantics.

selected.distinct_rationale: A real accepted hit moves the living enemy into a native Area2D; occupancy continuously energizes a distant original gate. Death or departure physically removes that support. The enemy is a functional world key to preserve, not an absorber to kill or an occupant to move out of a landing zone. Purpose allows single-shot/ground and later killing when the actual occupancy-crossing relation is achieved. Native original gate clock and anti-pinch remain in use.
selected.parent: enemy-world/live-knockback-aperture; preserved live-body world support

selected.parent: new physical supporting-gate topology

selected.name: 击退腾出落位

parameters.relationship: Actual enemy-body knockback clears the landing footprint; defeat is an allowed substitute if it truly clears that footprint

selected.distinct_rationale: v6 changes the physical lower bank to start x170 with thorns covering x170..188. Player center needs x>=200 to clear left thorns, but with enemy initial center225 and combined halfwidth26 needs x<=199 to avoid the enemy from the left. There is no stationary safe gap before displacement. One actual hit opens a landing gap; extra-hit and lethal alternatives are accepted, not suppressed by an alive-only requirement. This is physical occupancy displacement, unlike fixed volley removal of a projectile absorber. Old v3 broad-floor concern remains recorded; narrow goal alone is no longer the sole boundary.
selected.parent: live-enemy body displacement for physical landing clearance

selected.name: 反向击铃借墙折返

parameters.relationship: Leftward bell aim recoils away from leftward reward; wall kick reverses travel without refilling the spent air shot.

selected.distinct_rationale: Aiming at the required bell sends recoil away from the desired gate. The one spent airborne round cannot reverse again and wall jump does not refill it. A wall supplies the required direction reversal before timed closure. This is a nontrivial combination resolving incompatible aiming and travel direction, not two independent actions in series.

selected.name: 离台避险重接同台

parameters.relationship: continuous support evacuation and future interception

Stay aboard, late boarding, and skip-refuge alternatives fail physically; reward label alone does not enforce leaving.

selected.name: 弹丸穿运动射线窗

parameters.relationship: outgoing projectile path is periodically occluded by real moving platform; player never rides or touches shutter; choose launch/shot timing so projectile reaches actual clear ray

proposal_source.note: Historical design cards describe ancestry; selected case and frozen source bind the repaired exact geometry/semantics.

selected.distinct_rationale: Original moving slab controls whether the players projectile reaches the bell; the body does not ride or need cross the slab. One sampled blocked shot physically impacts inside the slab bounds before opening the short gate, while alternate firing/entry times reach the target. This is projectile-path anticipation, distinct from body hazard departure phase, autonomous moving support, or a stationary bell timed gate. Eleven successful other timings are accepted rather than hidden by phase labels.

selected.name: 缓降高度预算择窗

parameters.relationship: Wall slide consumes height at original 75 units/s while waiting for a moving mouth window; one extra cycle loses the launch band.
parameters.v4_counterexample_repair: Lower mouth top was an actual unintended landing/recharge step; add original top-face thorn to match guarded mouth claim.

proposal_source.note: Historical design cards describe ancestry; selected case and frozen source bind the repaired exact geometry/semantics.

selected.distinct_rationale: Wall attachment continuously loses height at the actual75-unit slide speed. High/low thorn mouths restrict the launch band while an autonomous saw restricts phase; waiting another cycle consumes the usable band and causes actual thorn damage. Repeated same-wall height resets fail. Unlike a stable hook observation point, waiting changes the future reachable space. Four successful blind-height/entry synchronization alternatives retain this shrinking height budget and are accepted. No stamina mechanism is invented.
selected.parent: autonomous hazard synchronization with irreversible height budget

selected.name: 可见双目标有序事务

parameters.relationship: both targets visible and hittable at entry; swapping the same two accepted projectile targets changes real final gate state; partial first-target progress persists

proposal_source.note: Historical design cards describe ancestry; selected case and frozen source bind the repaired exact geometry/semantics.

selected.distinct_rationale: Both receivers are already reachable by shooting from the starting area. Their real transactions do not commute: first-then-second unlocks, the same two hits in reverse order leave only primed progress. This cannot be reproduced by two independent simple gates, unlike the withdrawn serial spatial-lock distinction. Correct ground pre-opening plus another traversal shot and wrong-order recovery are valid and accepted, so no false airborne-only or finite-ammo requirement supports this count.
selected.parent: noncommutative target order; replaces serial spatial locks

selected.name: 先压门再取回载台

parameters.relationship: same carrier holds remote gate then is released for indispensable transport

proposal_source.note: Historical design cards describe ancestry; selected case and frozen source bind the repaired exact geometry/semantics.

selected.distinct_rationale: Same carrier is first stopped inside a real dock to keep a remote gate open, then must leave that dock to supply the support required for the post-gate long gap. Key duty and mobile support duty are mutually exclusive and require a handoff after the player can exploit the gate. This resolves the earlier body-type-only occupancy duplication. Wrong parking, never releasing, early release/access, and direct crossing alternatives fail physically.
selected.parent: external occupancy key plus mutually exclusive carrier duty
